## Description

plan-phase creates a position per phase when it promotes the phase. execute-phase picks the phase named in context when several run, closes the phase position at phase close, and supersedes the effort position. kinds-and-focus states the subject rules. Waits for handoff grouping so the documented layout holds.

payload.title: Per-phase position in plan-phase and execute-phase
